subject: NorthStar Summit results — lead quality & velocity reconciliation
messages:
From: Sarah Leong <sarah.leong@catalystanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15 09:12 PDT
Subject: NorthStar Summit pipeline discrepancy

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for sponsoring NorthStar last month. Our RevOps team pulled a post-event pipeline snapshot and we have $119,800 in influenced pipeline attributed to the summit (closed-source: first-touch event) for Catalyst opportunities created between 6/15–7/14. Your post-event summary that came over Friday shows $81,200 credited to the event.

Can you help reconcile the delta? A few notes from our side:
- Our export filters on HubSpot use the campaign tag "NS-SUMMIT-2026" and include offline deals marked as "sourced: event".
- We see several opportunities (9) that were created by our AEs but later merged with older contacts — that could explain double counting on our end.

We're happy to share our workbook and raw CRM export. If you can send your lead-level export (email, contact id, hubspot owner, campaign tag, created date, lifecycle stage, deal id) we can do a join and sort it out.

Attached: catalyst_pipeline_report_northstar_q2.xlsx (summary + pivot)

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Leong
Director, Revenue Operations
Catalyst Analytics

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Leong <sarah.leong@catalystanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit pipeline discrepancy

Hi Sarah —

Really appreciate the heads-up and the workbook. We want to get you a clean reconciliation. A couple quick points on how our post-event numbers were produced so you know what to expect:

1) Attribution approach: for sponsored events we run a hybrid attribution flow — event lead capture gets primary credit at first-touch, then we prorate if an earlier first-touch exists outside 90 days.
2) Deduping: our export removes exact-email duplicates and collapses contact merges, but if a deal was manually created under an existing contact that was later merged, it can slip into an "offline" bucket and not always pick up the event campaign tag.

Marcus/Laura — can you pull the lead-level export for NS (campaign id NS-2026-07) with the fields Sarah listed and include the contact merge history? Goal: produce a joined CSV matching Catalyst's keys by EOD tomorrow.

Sarah — we'll attach our export once Marcus has it. Can you also send the HubSpot contact IDs you used in your pivot so we can join on those directly?

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
Attachment: northstar_event_leads_export_2026-07-15.csv (will follow)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16 08:40 PDT
Subject: NorthStar — raw export + quick read

All —

I've exported the requested fields and included contact merge history and deal associations. High level from our side (export attached):
- Total event leads captured: 112
- Contacts with event campaign tag: 106
- Contacts de-duped by email: 9 (we merged 5 duplicate accounts during cleanup)
- Opportunities created from event leads in date window 6/15–7/14: 14
- Pipeline value tied to those opps (as of 7/15): $82,500

Notes on variance vs Catalyst's $119,800: after a first pass join I can see 9 deals in Catalyst's workbook that map to contacts in our CRM but are tagged as "offline" or were created under a legacy contact id that we collapsed in our export.

Attached: northstar_event_leads_export_2026-07-15.csv (CSV, 8 columns)

Next steps I recommend:
- Run a contact-id join between the two files (HubSpot id is the canonical key)
- For any deals created under a pre-merged contact, pick the most recent owner and reassign campaign attribution where appropriate
- If Catalyst wants full credit for their AE-created deals, we can create a reconciled tally and reflect it in the post-event summary PDF

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Leong <sarah.leong@catalystanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@catalystanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-16 14:55 PDT
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit pipeline discrepancy

Thanks Marcus / Kimberly —

We ran a quick join on HR IDs and found the same 9 contacts that were causing the bulk of the difference (we've attached the filtered list of deals tied to those contacts). Our reconciliation asks:

1) Can Redwood deliver a reconciled CSV that marks the canonical contact id, the merged email, and the final deal id so our AEs can update the record on our side?
2) For the purposes of the sponsorship report, we request that Redwood include those 9 deals in the event-attributed pipeline total. Those deals were initiated at the summit by our reps (demo requests / in-booth conversations) and closing was driven by us.

If it's helpful, Tom and I are available for a 30-min screen-share tomorrow to run through the join and confirm the mapping.

Attachment: catalyst_filtered_deals_for_merge.csv

Best,
Sarah

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Leong <sarah.leong@catalystanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-17 10:22 PDT
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit pipeline discrepancy — agreed reconciliation + action items

Sarah / Tom —

Thanks for the quick analysis and for flagging the nine deals. We completed the contact-id join this morning and produced a reconciled file (attached). Summary of what we did and the proposed outcome:

- Reconciled lead-match: northstar-reconciled-lead-match.csv — includes hubspot_contact_id, merged_email, original_owner, final_owner, event_campaign_tag, deal_id(s).
- Net change: our public post-event total will be updated from $81,200 -> $111,900 to reflect the 9 additional deals you requested to be included (we prorated where there was split-ownership).
- We've added a one-page supplement to the post-event PDF documenting the reconciliation logic and the specific contact merges (see northstar-retro-notes.md in the shared drive)

Action items:
1) Kimberley (Redwood field ops) will update the public post-event summary PDF and push a new version to the Drive by EOD today.
2) Catalyst RevOps to apply the reconciled hubspot_contact_id mappings on your side to ensure both systems show the same canonical records (Sarah/Tom).
3) Laura will open a short ticket with Product (JIRA MK-1127) to add a required campaign-id validation step to the event lead form to reduce offline-created deals falling outside the campaign tag.

If you're good with the reconciliation we will finalize the sponsorship report and send an updated summary to your leadership. We can also schedule a brief retro in early August to capture process improvements.

Thanks again for being collaborative here — glad we could resolve quickly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

Attachments: northstar-reconciled-lead-match.csv; northstar-retro-notes.md
Link: https://hubspot.com/lists/76023-northstar-event-leads
